description: This file contains Drupal hooks related to the Database system and Schema API, including documentation, schema definitions, and query alteration hooks.

methods.name: hook_schema
methods.description: Defines the database schema for the 'users_data' table, including fields, keys, and indexes.

methods.name: hook_query_alter
methods.description: Allows modules to alter a structured database query before execution.

methods.name: hook_query_TAG_alter
methods.description: Allows modules to alter queries with specific tags, e.g., to restrict media entity access.
